slides.text: An AI agent that invents your prices isn't intake. It's a liability.
slides.voiceover_text: Here's the thing. An AI agent that invents prices, or books a slot that doesn't exist, isn't handling your intake. It's a liability.

slides.text: Lock down what it can say
slides.voiceover_text: Tip one: configure hard output boundaries, so it never quotes a fee or a service your firm doesn't offer.
Tip two: define exactly when it hands off to a human, so complex matters reach your team fast.
Tip three: give it a never-say list. No legal advice, no guarantees, no made-up policies.

slides.text: Control is what turns a voice agent into booked clients
slides.voiceover_text: So remember: control is the difference between a booked consultation and a confused caller.
